answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops fakes. Each agent locks a 20-unit deposit and a referral link, passing a velvet rope. A prism splits light; the graph does the same, exposing a fake cluster like a dune field. Peers may dispute a suspect; failure burns its deposit and slashes its referrer. Forging 1,000 aliases costs 20,000 units against at most 50 a day, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay one refundable deposit and keep full rewards.
